patch.value: Dependabot alert #43: PostCSS previous source-map path traversal (GHSA-r28c-9q8g-f849)

Resolve GitHub Dependabot alert #43 for transitive development dependency postcss 8.5.16, vulnerable through 8.5.17 to arbitrary .map file disclosure when auto-loading previous source maps. Upgrade the lockfile graph to postcss 8.5.18 or newer through the owning Vite/Vitest dependency path, preserve release-age and supply-chain policy, and prove the alert closes without weakening any gate.

pnpm why postcss resolves only patched versions >=8.5.18; GitHub Dependabot alert #43 is closed; lockfile supply-chain policy, audit, static analysis, exact coverage, compatibility, package smoke, and exact-head DeepScan/CodeFactor gates pass; fix ships in the next PR and is linked from the alert follow-up lineage.
pnpm-lock.yaml; transitive development dependency postcss 8.5.16 via vite 7.3.5 and vitest 4.1.10
Read GitHub Dependabot alert 43 and run pnpm why postcss; current graph resolves one version, postcss 8.5.16, while the first patched version is 8.5.18.
The resolved postcss version is at least 8.5.18, Dependabot alert #43 is closed, and the full security/static/coverage/release suite passes.
Main 1847f891 resolves postcss 8.5.16 through vite 7.3.5/vitest 4.1.10; Dependabot alert #43 is open at high severity.
Development-only transitive exposure; crafted sourceMappingURL input processed by affected tooling could disclose arbitrary .map files.
